{{Top|leg}}
A '''Celebrity Bobble Head''' was model of a famous person with a bobble head that could be placed in the front of a vehicle or [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. Some were sold by [[Nenmo's Curios]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], where bobble heads of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], and a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] could be purchased.<ref name="For Fun and Profit">{{LivingForce|For Fun and Profit}}</ref>
